find: return new Set(pads.filter((p) => p.unsupported !== undefined).map((p) => p.padIndex));
why: Issue #713. The one verdict both automatic-assignment sites read comes back empty, so campaign seeding and the Versus Setup pane both bind a slot to a pad the reader samples as neutral every tick, and Start is not refused. The seeding and pane suites pass their own pads through this function, so they would fail too; this entry scopes the helper's own case, which is the one that names the verdict directly.
killedBy: unreadablePadIndices: the one verdict automatic assignment skips (issue #713) names exactly the detected pads carrying an unsupported reason
